state_compatibility.publication: One captured source manifest, parent-owned journal and catalog, durable projection acknowledgements, read leases, recovery before new publication.
state_compatibility.source_root: Canonical workspace source; never replaced by stateRoot.
state_compatibility.stores: Physically contained generation directories. Rebuild uses a new generation; old bytes are retained.
state_compatibility.legacy_state: .codegraph and .zvec-grep are not adopted, migrated or mutated by the unified path.
state_compatibility.external_products: No external zg/codegraph/Serena MCP CLI on the normal query path; no machine daemon restart.

shared_inputs.prepared_transport: Content-hashed private spool references; graph stages all parts and acknowledges durable application only on the final part. Captured source/metadata/file-existence lookups cannot fall back to live disk.
shared_inputs.parser_policy: Separate native/WASM extractors retain their own grammar/runtime ABI. Snapshot parity is not parser convergence.

semantic.configuration: Explicit canonical executable per language; unsupported server capability is unavailable, not empty.
semantic.observations: Own LSP document version, raw-file/buffer hashes, position encoding and diagnostics completion only; no foreign editor-buffer claim. Fresh empty push/pull reports clear errors; silence is not_reported.
semantic.text_roles: source excerpts are checked against exact UTF-8 spans; descriptions qualify their anchor without pretending to quote source. Common captured bytes and hash fences validate public semantic excerpts; invalid/outside paths and malformed coordinates are not complete evidence.
